title: Normalized completion of one ordinary pullback
statement: Fix a prime l and a finite field extension E of Q_l. For every morphism f:X to Y of schemes, there is a normalized OpenFactorCoherence.Pull l E f. This includes the good-complex preservation assertions, the strict quotient tower comparison and its scalar-unit generator identity, and the localized comparison with its representative equation. No tensor or open comparison is asserted.

source.place: Coefficient-comparison sentence; expanded strict-system realization argument, as recorded in lem-sf-integral-canonical-ambient-models.

proof.text: The completed-ring structure map and the ambient coefficient map agree because their finite projections are the same canonical constant-section maps. The resulting direct-image comparison is identity on underlying sections. Uniqueness of left adjoints gives the ordinary pullback comparison, carrying the actual adjunction-unit generators to the ambient unit generators. Apply it degreewise. Transport preservation of K-flatness and flat terms and the normalized strict quotient-tower isomorphism from the ambient presentation; naturality of quotient generators proves precisely the generators field of Pull. On good complexes, the actual ordinary derived pullback factors through this transported good lift. The strict tower comparison induces the Roos comparison. Fully faithful whiskering by the good-complex localization descends this presentation to the comparison from ordinary pullback followed by completion to integralDerivedPullback. Its descent normalization is Pull.model. Assemble the source-good proof, target-good proof, strict tower, generator equation and descended comparison. Identity maps, empty schemes and zero complexes use exactly the same formulas.
